trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is no shortcut and no single trick to it. It needs the full story, the 100% checklist behind A Long Road, and every side trophy on this list. Work this tracker stage by stage and let the platinum arrive on its own; the usual estimate for the whole road is around 200 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

Reach 100% completion for A Long Road.
Clear every remaining side trophy below.

Start the first mission of Chapter 2.

Start Chapter 3.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)

steps: Play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 to the end.

trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story and work the checklist. It wants every robbery in full (8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations), every underwater discovery, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks — plus a share of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Nothing on the list is missable, and anything you did before the story ends already counts. This is the longest grind on the road to platinum, roughly 100 hours of the estimated 200 total.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — 100% Completion Requirements

steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear the full-requirement items first: robberies, vaults, gang operations, discoveries, range golds, drone races, Target Decks.
Top up the shared items to their targets: missions, scans, studies, meditations, challenges, stunts, WAiNK scans.

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to pile them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not required. Track the count under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Turn on stunt markers on the map.
Fly under bridges for the quickest count.
Reach 250 stunts; push to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt. Most of these happen naturally while playing; check Progress, then Activities, to see what is left.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Try one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade, a race win, a stunt.
Check Progress > Activities for anything still untried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. There is no shortcut — every challenge needs gold, so treat each range as its own small skill test and repeat the ones you miss. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting ranges.
Earn gold in all 42 challenges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location properly while you are there instead of coming back later.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Win one drone race at each of the 14 locations.
Clear all 42 drone races for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 available. Winning the same race again does not count, so pick a fresh one each time and keep a mental note of which you have already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Win a race you have not won before.
Repeat with 19 more different races.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Meet Cal in Feng Shui (Chapter 1).
Follow his texts to the marked fishing spot.
Play his fishing quests and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them are on the TV at home, and the fourth is on arcade cabinets around Leonida — pick whichever you find first and play it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Find an arcade game at home or on a cabinet.
Play it to the end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order; the last one awards the trophy. The line stays available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: In Chapter 3, wait for Andy's text to Lucia.
Play all five of Andy's missions in order.
Finish the last one.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from seven shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Meet Kenton in Chapter 1 and take the treasure job.
Dive the seven shipwreck markers and dig up each chest.
Finish the line when Kenton texts Jason again.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth job awards the trophy, and the line stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
Play all five of Billy's jobs.
Finish the fifth job.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list to confirm the remaining strands, and note that none of them are needed for 100%.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)

steps: Take on stranger strands as they appear on the map.
Finish eight qualifying strands; check the trophy counter for progress.

trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds, and cars in better condition pay more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 to open Randy's Wish List.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK to find the 16 on his list.
Deliver all 16 to his garage in west Vice City.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job awards the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3), take Tyrone's jobs as Jason.
Destroy the purple-marked synthetic labs.
Finish his last job.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. WARNING — possibly missable: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1 and it is not confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do not skip it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps: In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony — do not skip this.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), meditate together at the remaining spots.
Reach 18 meditations on the counter.

trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. The 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet.

Start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks as Jason.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Open Progress > Collections to see each card set's progress.
Complete any three sets.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app. Any 100 count, from Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures and the No Flusher tags — so scan whatever you pass while exploring instead of hunting one type only.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)

Scan 100 spots: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)

Complete 50 challenges; push to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Call your partner, get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape; it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well, and bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)

Build a 4-star Wanted Level.
Escape until you are out of the red heat zone.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while you are still wanted. Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City are close together, which makes the run short. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)

Rob three shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level.
Wait a few seconds for the trophy; rob a fourth shop if it does not pop.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Open the WAiNK app near a busy road.
Scan 100 different vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single Combat Focus. It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)

steps: Fill your Focus meter first.
Find a gang operation with grouped thugs.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down five of them in one use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest to reach.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Get into VCIA and reach a departure gate jet (E3 or E4).
Steal the jet, back it out and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks are at the south end of the base — and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)

steps: Reach Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County.
Steal a tank from the south end of the base.
Take out enemies from inside the tank.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm — find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3).
Open a jewelry store's back door quietly with the Snap Gun.
Find the safe code note and empty the safe unseen.

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. Five of the eight vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all eight, and each pays up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Unlock vaults with That's Where The Money Is… (Chapter 4).
Follow a security van to its bank and enter the vault.
Hand a bag to your partner, then escape. Repeat for five vaults.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. You can box one in, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away — or rob a bank vault, which counts too, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Box in an armored truck and sticky-bomb its back doors.
Grab the cash and escape the heat zone.

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the map is fully revealed.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Take a plane and fly over every dark patch of the map.
Keep going until no fog is left.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation from each of the nine gangs (yellow map icons); Progress, then Gangs, keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to the full set.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Find yellow illegal-operation icons on the map.
Rob one operation from each of the nine gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. The exact steps are not confirmed yet — this guide will not invent them. Check the linked source for updates as players confirm the trigger.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)

steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Find a bar with a view and order a cocktail.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom. The exact steps are not confirmed yet; check the linked source for updates rather than guessing.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (exact steps unconfirmed)

steps: Find a vehicle showroom in Vice City.
Drive a car out through its window.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)

steps: Unlock Kingpin Bowling with Hit Kingpin Bowling (Chapter 2).
Take the watch, the shotgun and the safe.
Lose the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)

Train Strength with your partner until both are maxed.

Reach 500 actions — without pushing towards Irredeemable.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (exact steps unconfirmed)

steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners and events.
Check the linked source for the confirmed trigger.

trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by. The exact steps are not confirmed yet.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (exact steps unconfirmed)

steps: Attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle.
Check the linked source for the confirmed trigger.

trophies.guide: Credit Check in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Get the Dye Pack Jammer in Credit Check (Chapter 3).
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Sell the bills to fences until $250,000 is laundered.

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest, so buy what you need for the other trophies and this one fills itself.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Spend across shops as you play.
Guns, car mods and tattoos count fastest.
Reach $100,000 in total spending.

trophies.guide: Buy the eight garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The four garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: After Daily Driver (Chapter 2), open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all eight garages for sale.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (official list, via Planet GTA 6)
